search_datasets.description: Search the whole Madrid catalogue by words in a dataset's title, description or tags, and narrow it by category, tag, file format or publishing body. Picking several values for one filter widens the result (any of them matches); filling in different filters narrows it (all of them must match). Leave the words blank to browse a filter on its own: every dataset tagged 'movilidad', say. Each result comes back with its files, formats, licence and when it was last updated.
